meanings.meaning: verb (past tense of lose). 迷路
meanings.usage: lose one's way 表示迷路，lose的过去式为lost
作名词指德语，作形容词指德国的
ask someone the way 向某人问路
tell someone something 告诉某人某事
find something 找到某物，过去式为found

phrases.usage: 迷路，指找不到要去的地方

examples.en: She lost her way in London.
The tourists lost their way in the forest.
examples.zh: 游客们在森林里迷路了。

examples.en: I can ask him the way.
May I ask you the way to the station?
examples.zh: 我可以向你问一下去车站的路吗？

phrases.phrase: Can you tell me the way to...?
phrases.usage: 你能告诉我去...的路吗？用于礼貌地问路

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去国王街的路吗？

examples.en: Can you tell me the way to the museum?
examples.zh: 你能告诉我去博物馆的路吗？

phrases.usage: 打扰一下，用于引起注意或打扰别人前

examples.en: Excuse me, can you help me?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，你能帮帮我吗？

examples.en: Excuse me, is this your pen?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，这是你的钢笔吗？

examples.en: He put his hand into his pocket.
examples.zh: 他把他的手伸进口袋里。

examples.en: She put her hand into the bag.

phrases.usage: 对不起/很抱歉，用于道歉或表达遗憾

examples.en: I am sorry, I do not speak English.
I am sorry, I am late.

phrases.usage: /bʌs stɒp/ noun phrase. 公共汽车站（公交车停靠的地方）

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Past Simple Tense)
grammar.structure:
主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他
主语 + did not (didn't) + 动词原形 + 其他
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态，常与表示过去的时间状语连用，如last week, yesterday等。 用于叙述过去发生的事情，描述一系列按时间顺序发生的动作

examples.en: Last week Mrs. Mills went to London.
examples.zh: 上周 Mills 夫人去了伦敦。

grammar.title: 一般过去时的否定句和疑问句
grammar.structure:
否定句: 主语 + did not + 动词原形 + 其他
一般疑问句: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？
grammar.definition: 否定句在动词前加did not (didn't)，动词恢复原形。疑问句将did提到句首。 用于对过去发生的动作进行否定或提问

grammar.title: 一般过去时与一般现在时的对比
grammar.structure:
现在时: 主语 + 动词原形/三单形式
过去时: 主语 + 动词过去式
grammar.definition: 一般现在时描述习惯性或经常发生的动作；一般过去时描述过去发生的具体事件。 在叙述故事时，背景描述用现在时，具体事件用过去时

examples.en: She does not know London very well.
examples.zh: 她对伦敦不太熟悉。（现在时，描述一般状态）
她迷路了。（过去时，描述过去事件）

patterns.pattern: Can you tell me the way to + 地点?

original.en: Can you tell me the way to King Street, please?
original.zh: 你能告诉我去国王街的路吗？

imitations.en: Can you tell me the way to the station?
imitations.zh: 你能告诉我去车站的路吗？

imitations.en: Can you tell me the way to the airport?
imitations.zh: 你能告诉我去机场的路吗？

imitations.en: Can you tell me the way to the museum?
imitations.zh: 你能告诉我去博物馆的路吗？

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词过去式 + 其他 (叙述过去事件)

original.en: She saw a man near a bus stop.
original.zh: 她在公共汽车站附近看到一个男人。

imitations.en: She went to London last week.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + did not + 动词原形 (过去时否定)

imitations.en: I did not see him yesterday.
She did not know the way.

patterns.pattern: I am sorry, I do not speak + 语言

original.en: I am sorry, I do not speak English.

imitations.en: I am sorry, I do not speak French.
I am sorry, I do not speak Japanese.
I am sorry, I do not speak German.

lines.en: Last week Mrs Mills went to London. She does not know London very well, and she lost her way.
Suddenly, she saw a man near a bus-stop. “ I can ask him the way.” She said to herself.
“Can you tell me the way to King Street please?”
The man smiled pleasantly. He did not understand English!  He spoke German. He was a tourist.
Then he put his hand into his pocket, and took out a phrase-book.
He opened the book and found a phrase. He read the phrase slowly.
“I am sorry,” he said. “ I do not speak English.”
He does not know me very well.
She drank a glass of water thirstily.

questions.q: Why did the man need a phrasebook?

translation:
上星期米尔斯夫人去了伦敦。她对伦敦不很熟悉，因此迷了路。
突然，她在公共汽车站附近看到一个男人。“我可以向他问路，”她想。
“对不起，您能告诉我到国王街怎么走吗？”她说。
这人友好地笑了笑。他不懂英语！他讲德语。他是个旅游者。
然后他把手伸进了衣袋，掏出了一本常用语手册。
他翻开书找到了一条短语。他缓慢地读着短语。
”很抱歉，“他说，”我不会讲英语。”
